scope: COV-017ai/COV-020j: dictionary-listed literary assertion -(으)니라/-느니라, known structural classes, finite lexical dictionary conflicts, and vowel-final omitted copulas.
source_attribution: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, September 2026 export. All reviewed notes and senses retained, with up to two example groups.

notes: ‘ㄹ’을 제외한 받침 있는 형용사 뒤에 붙여 쓴다.

senses.definition: (아주낮춤으로)(옛 말투로) 일반적인 진리나 경험에서 나온 당연한 사실을 가르쳐 줄 때 쓰는 종결 어미.
examples: 사람은 앉아 있으면 누워 있고 싶으니라.
여기에서부터는 길이 좋지 않으니 걸어가는 것이 좋으니라.

notes: ‘이다’, 받침이 없거나 ‘ㄹ’ 받침인 형용사 또는 ‘-으시-’ 뒤에 붙여 쓴다.

senses.definition: (아주낮춤으로)(옛 말투로) 일반적인 진리나 경험에서 나온 당연한 사실을 가르쳐 줄 때 쓰는 종결 어미.

examples: 지는 것이 이기는 것일 때가 있느니라.

remaining: Historical use of 니라 as a tense marker is outside this dictionary-listed modern literary family; no general historical/dialect grammar is inferred.

KRDict -으니라 attests 되지는 않으니라. Negative inheritance and existential/honorific subtleties are preserved rather than categorically rejected from inherited verb POS. Further independent review remains COV-019h.
Unknown lexical heads remain hypotheses; the optional dictionary filter only checks bare lexical adjective/verb conflicts, with existential unknowns and honorific/past/modal licenses preserved.
Other following particles, auxiliaries and contextual suitability remain unreviewed.

먹으니라 retains a token-initial auxiliary homonym as unknown despite conflicts for lexical verb entries. This is the existing separately-written-auxiliary boundary, not evidence that the bare lexical verb attachment is licensed.

The novel adds 아 + 이다 + 으니라 for 57 아니라 tokens through ordinary nominal/copula ambiguity. These contextually unjudged candidates are retained separately from the existing 아니다 reading, not counted as precision gains.
The inherited nominal + subject 이 + omitted copula path also creates alternatives for 뿐이니라 and 것들이니라; broader particle-marked copula bases remain COV-020.
The existing bundled obligation 어야겠 can occupy 느니라's modal slot; contextual interpretation remains unjudged.

unjudged_observations.reason: Known adjectival inheritance does not settle every literary negative paradigm; preserve for review, without required/forbidden judgment.
